description:
As a prospective customer
  I want to create a web shop account
  So that I can access customer shopping features

steps.name: I am on the web shop home page
I open the registration form from the header
I register as a "male" customer named "random" "random" with email "random", password "random" and confirm password "match"
my registration should complete successfully
I should be logged in with my new account
I am on the web shop home page
I open the registration form from the header
I register as a "female" customer named "random" "random" with email "random", password "random" and confirm password "match"
my registration should complete successfully
I should be logged in with my new account
I am on the web shop home page
I open the registration form from the header
I register as a "female" customer named "Thandi" "Mokoena" with email "random", password "Passw0rd!23" and confirm password "match"
my registration should complete successfully
I should be logged in with my new account

elements.name: Reject a registration with missing required fields

steps.name: I am on the web shop home page
I open the registration form from the header
I register as a "male" customer named "" "random" with email "random", password "random" and confirm password "match"
the registration should be rejected with validation feedback
I should see the validation message "First name is required."
